description: Source code implementing a cross-platform setproctitle function for Linux and Darwin (macOS), including environment and argument manipulation to change process titles.

methods.name: spt_clearenv
methods.description: Clears the environment variables, using either clearenv() or a manual method.

methods.name: spt_copyenv
methods.description: Copies the environment variables into a new buffer, restoring environment after modification.

methods.name: spt_copyargs
methods.description: Duplicates command-line arguments for safe manipulation.

methods.name: spt_init
methods.description: Initializes the process title manipulation by copying environment and arguments, and setting up internal structures.

methods.name: setproctitle
methods.description: Sets the process title by overwriting argv[0] and related memory, formatted with printf-style arguments.
